gen.title: Tracing water through the hydrologic cycle
gen.orderNote: Follow the cycle in text order from evaporation to runoff and back again

steps.label: Water evaporates from liquid to gas
steps.quote: Evaporation is the change of state in a substance from a liquid to a gas.

steps.label: Plants release water through stomata
steps.quote: Transpiration is the evaporation of water from plants through stomata.

steps.label: Water vapor condenses into liquid
steps.quote: Condensation is the process whereby water vapor is changed into a liquid state.

steps.label: Water falls as precipitation to earth
steps.quote: Precipitation results when tiny condensation particles, through collision and coalescence, grow too large for the rising air to support

steps.label: Excess water flows as runoff
steps.quote: Runoff occurs when there is excessive precipitation and the ground is saturated (cannot absorb any more water).

steps.label: Cycle restarts as runoff evaporates again
steps.quote: Evaporation of this runoff into the atmosphere begins the hydrologic cycle over again.
